title: Rise & Fall Tale definitions (variant)
description: The Tales variant's numbered elements. Each Tale is self-contained: everything it adds (extra unit kinds, extra actions on existing cards, movement overrides) is only merged into a game's effective content when that Tale's id is in the active set for that game — see src/engine/tales.ts's applyTaleModifiers. A base game with no Tales active never reads this file's effects at all.

number.description: The Tale's rulebook number — precedence order when multiple active Tales resolve simultaneously (lowest first).

description.description: Flavor/rules text, written from scratch (no reproduced rulebook text).

extraUnits.description: New unit kinds this Tale introduces, e.g. The Ports' Port. Each has no Civilization card of its own — it activates as a companion whenever companionOfKind's card is played (see engine/applyAction.ts's applyResolveUnitAction).

extraActionsByKind.description: Extra actions appended onto an EXISTING unit kind's action list, keyed by that kind's id (e.g. Nomad and Ship both gain a Construct a Port action for The Ports).

movementOverridesByKind.description: Movement field overrides merged onto an EXISTING unit kind's base movement, keyed by that kind's id (e.g. Ship gains canEndMoveOnAlliedUnitTypes: ['port']). Free-form per-field overrides, not a full movement object — see units.schema.json's movement shape for the fields being overridden.

fantasticEvents.description: Fantastic Events this Tale contributes, resolved in ascending Tale-number order whenever two or more players must recycle their hand in the same round (see engine/round.ts's finishRound).

controllableStructures.description: End-of-game 'control a unique piece' VP bonuses this Tale contributes (e.g. The Cathedral) — see engine/victoryPoints.ts's calculateControllableStructureVP.

companionOfKind.description: The existing unit kind id whose card also activates this companion kind's units.

requiredUnitKind.description: Unit kind id every non-eliminated player must control at least one of for this event to trigger; that same kind's units are then all removed from the board (returned to reserve) when it does.

kind.description: Unit kind id — whoever controls at least one unit of this kind at game end scores victoryPoints.

effect.description: Same free-form convention as units.schema.json's action.effect — shape is given by src/engine/unitContent.ts's UnitActionEffect union.
